documents.summary: Appendix C of the Academic Integrity Policy for undergraduates gives instructors the right to decide whether AI is allowed and requires them to describe permitted use in writing. Students must follow each instructor's rules, cite AI, and own what they submit; where no guidance is given, AI is treated as assistance from another person. Sample statements run from prohibition to required use.
